title: Studio Interfaces pillar: a leaf edit whose save was refused (422) is seen by no unsaved-changes guard, so a reload drops it silently
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from the #29022 dev's reading at `origin/main` `5d3667e2` · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** In Studio's Interfaces pillar (reports, dashboards and other leaf items), when the server refuses a leaf's autosave (422), the edit stays on screen but nothing treats it as unsaved: no "leave page?" prompt, no header guard, no rail marker. A reload drops the edit with no warning. #29022 closes one door into this (a Joined report with no blocks); any other refused leaf save still loses work silently.

**Measured (source reading, NOT MEASURED at a public door).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `InterfacesPillar`: only `navDirty` is mirrored through `onDirtyChange`.
- `heldEdit` carries held clauses only; a leaf save refused by the server is neither held nor dirty to the guards (`beforeunload`, header, rail).

**Wanted.**
1. While the open leaf's last save was refused and it still has edits, the pillar reports dirty, so `beforeunload` and the header guard ask before the edit is lost.
2. A successful save, or loading another leaf, clears it.
3. No new metadata key or option.

**Tests.** A leaf edit refused with a 422 makes the guard ask on reload; a successful save afterwards clears it; an untouched leaf never asks.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`area:studio`). Size S. Waits for #29015 (holds `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`).

**Dedupe.** Searched `InterfacesPillar onDirtyChange refused save`, `studio leaf 422 lost reload`: only #29022.

Links back: #29022.
